$comment: Binds this repo to the Tally Jira project and Confluence space. No secrets here; commit it so the mapping travels between machines.

jira.$epicStrategy_note: TALLY is team-managed (style: next-gen, simplified: true), so an epic is the parent issue. No Epic Link customfield.
jira.$repoLabel_note: One repo, one project. Leave null unless a second repo joins.
jira.$boardId_note: The TALLY board. Read sprint state from it; never open or close a sprint automatically.

confluence.$rootPageId_note: Set during init to the 'Product requirements' page: the parent of the mirrored docs tree.
confluence.$largeDocs_note: Published as a substantial summary plus a link to the Git file rather than mirrored whole. Both are over 100 KB, BACKEND_PRD is mostly DDL, and the connector's edge WAF rejects bodies containing SQL and shell operators. Git stays authoritative for these two and the pages say so.

session.$handoffPageId_note: Set during init to the Session Log page.
